Pivot

      
Pivot = any of the 9 points of the selection's box (corners included); it also sets the pivot for the corner rotate grips. Live preview. Enter = apply, Esc = cancel.

    

    

  





  

    
Trace Bitmap

    

      
      
      
      
      
      
      
—

      
Traced contours land on the "trace" layer, ready to pocket / profile / V-carve. The bitmap stays underneath as a reference.

Drag corner gripRotate about the pivot · Shift = snap to Rot ° increment

Zoom inGrid subdivides with zoom (0.5 → 0.25 → 0.1 → … → 0.0001"); zoom goes to 40000 px/in

Hold CtrlNo object snap either (fully free)

        
Arrow keysNudge selection 0.001" · Shift 0.1" · Alt/Option 0.0001"

Cmd/Ctrl+G · Shift+GGroup · Ungroup the selection
